notes: One contradiction, and it is internal: NOTES calls the filter-footer hint (3 km 内有 4 个) the largest relaxation, but the arm's own empty state shows 改成明天 with 6. It fits the empty state's stated order (smallest change first) better than 'largest', so 最大 looks like a wording slip rather than a rendering error. Everything else is verified. NOTES says large-font and real-device checks were not done, which matches what is visible (default size only).
